en.name: Bad Omen
en.ability: You do not know you are a Bad Omen. You think you are a Townsfolk, but you receive false information. You might register as evil, even if dead.

revisions.v1: You do not know you are a Bad Omen. You think you are a Townsfolk, but you receive false information. You might register as evil, even if dead.

en.flavor: "Beware the Ides of March." - Gaius Julius Caesar 100 B.C. - 44 B.C.
